{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CenW3YM9vdWqjQbYjXEir","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01RYbFN1vY9ewcJgDZ8zJUjF","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20260901-162328/cholesky_claude-sonnet-5-cc-medium_hybrid_r3/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","content":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <unordered_map>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include <cublas_v2.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <cusolverDn.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA blocked (right-looking) Cholesky decomposition.\n//\n// The matrix is partitioned into column-panels of width NB, which are\n// distributed cyclically (column j -> rank j % nranks) across MPI ranks.\n// Each rank owns its panels in device (GPU) memory. For step k of the\n// right-looking algorithm the owner of panel k factorizes the diagonal\n// block (cuSOLVER potrf) and solves the panel below it (cuBLAS trsm) on\n// its assigned GPU, then broadcasts the panel to every rank via MPI. Each\n// rank then applies the trailing update (cuBLAS gemm) to the panels it\n// owns; independent updates within a step are dispatched concurrently\n// across CUDA streams using OpenMP threads.\n//\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,         \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                                    \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                         \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n#define CUBLAS_CHECK(call)                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cublasStatus_t st_ = (call);                                              \\\n        if (st_ != CUBLAS_STATUS_SUCCESS) {                                       \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"cuBLAS error %s:%d: status %d\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__, \\\n                    (int)st_);                                                    \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                         \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n#define CUSOLVER_CHECK(call)                                                       \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cusolverStatus_t st_ = (call);                                            \\\n        if (st_ != CUSOLVER_STATUS_SUCCESS) {                                     \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"cuSOLVER error %s:%d: status %d\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__, \\\n                    (int)st_);                                                    \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                         \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\nnamespace {\n\nconstexpr int kNumStreams = 4;\n\n// Block-panel geometry helpers for a column-cyclic distribution with panel width NB.\ninline size_t numBlocks(size_t n, size_t NB) { return (n + NB - 1) / NB; }\ninline size_t rowStart(size_t j, size_t NB) { return j * NB; }\ninline size_t rowCount(size_t j, size_t n, size_t NB) { return n - j * NB; }\ninline size_t colWidth(size_t j, size_t n, size_t NB) {\n    return std::min(NB, n - j * NB);\n}\n\n// Distributed hybrid MPI+OpenMP+CUDA blocked Cholesky decomposition.\n// On entry/exit, `A` (row-major, n x n) holds the full matrix only on rank 0;\n// on other ranks it is unused. Returns the same success value on every rank.\nbool choleskyDecompositionDistributed(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, int rank,\n                                       int nranks, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    if (n == 0) return true;\n\n    // Assign one GPU per rank (round-robin across GPUs visible on the local node).\n    MPI_Comm localComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(comm, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &localComm);\n    int localRank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(localComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&localComm);\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    const int deviceId = deviceCount > 0 ? (localRank % deviceCount) : 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(deviceId));\n\n    cublasHandle_t cublasH;\n    cusolverDnHandle_t cusolverH;\n    CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasCreate(&cublasH));\n    CUSOLVER_CHECK(cusolverDnCreate(&cusolverH));\n\n    cudaStream_t streams[kNumStreams];\n    cublasHandle_t gemmHandles[kNumStreams];\n    for (int s = 0; s < kNumStreams; ++s) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&streams[s]));\n        CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasCreate(&gemmHandles[s]));\n        CUBLAS_CHECK(cublasSetStream(gemmHandles[s], streams[s]));\n    }\n\n    const size_t NB = std::min<size_t>(256, n);\n    const size_t nb = numBlocks(n, NB);\n\n    // Panels owned by this rank (cyclic distribution: owner(j) = j % nranks).\n    std::vector<size_t> owned;\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < nb; ++j) {\n        if (static_cast<int>(j % static_cast<size_t>(nranks)) == rank) owned.push_back(j);\n    }\n\n    std::unordered_map<size_t, double*> deviceCol;\n    for (size_t j : owned) {\n        const size_t cnt = rowCount(j, n, NB) * colWidth(j, n, NB);\n        double* d = nullptr;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d, cnt * sizeof(double)));\n        deviceCol[j] = d;\n    }\n\n    // --- Distribute panels from rank 0 (row-major) into column-major device buffers ---\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < nb; ++j) {\n        const size_t ld = rowCount(j, n, NB);\n        const size_t cw = colWidth(j, n, NB);\n        const size_t cnt = ld * cw;\n        const int owner = static_cast<int>(j % static_cast<size_t>(nranks));\n        const size_t rs = rowStart(j, NB);\n\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            std::vector<double> buf(cnt);\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t c = 0; c < cw; ++c) {\n                for (size_t r = 0; r < ld; ++r) {\n                    buf[c * ld + r] = A[(rs + r) * n + (rs + c)];\n                }\n            }\n            if (owner == 0) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(deviceCol[j], buf.data(), cnt * sizeof(double),\n                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            } else {\n                MPI_Send(buf.data(), static_cast<int>(cnt), MPI_DOUBLE, owner,\n                         static_cast<int>(j), comm);\n            }\n        } else if (rank == owner) {\n            std::vector<double> buf(cnt);\n            MPI_Recv(buf.data(), static_cast<int>(cnt), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, static_cast<int>(j), comm,\n                     MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(deviceCol[j], buf.data(), cnt * sizeof(double),\n <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Simple Cholesky decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    \n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n    \n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n    \n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    if (!success) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n    double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(A, \"CholeskyL\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CenXhXnbZYoXN2DLrtieE","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The implementation is complete and verified. Summary of changes:\n\n**`cholesky/cholesky.cpp`** — replaced the sequential unblocked Cholesky with a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA blocked right-looking algorithm:\n- Matrix is split into column-panels distributed cyclically across MPI ranks (`owner(j) = j % nranks`), each rank's panels living in GPU memory.\n- Each MPI rank is bound to one GPU (round-robin via node-local rank).\n- Diagonal-block factorization uses cuSOLVER (`cusolverDnDpotrf`); panel solves and trailing updates use cuBLAS (`dtrsm`/`dgemm`).\n- Panel data is broadcast to all ranks via `MPI_Bcast` after each diagonal step (skipped entirely for single-rank runs).\n- Trailing-matrix updates for panels owned by a rank are dispatched concurrently across CUDA streams using OpenMP threads (with per-thread `cudaSetDevice`, since each OS thread has its own CUDA context).\n- `generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix` and `validateCholesky` gained OpenMP parallel loops, preserving bit-identical results to the original sequential algorithm (only independent outer-row work is parallelized).\n- Positive-definiteness failure is detected and agreed on across ranks via a broadcast flag, matching original error reporting semantics.\n\n**`cholesky/CMakeLists.txt`** — added `find_package(MPI)`, `find_package(OpenMP)`, `find_package(CUDAToolkit)`, and linked `MPI::MPI_CXX`, `OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX`, `CUDA::cudart`, `CUDA::cublas`, `CUDA::cusolver`.\n\nVerified correctness (`-v`) across 1/2/3/4 ranks, edge cases (n=1, small blocks, non-multiple-of-block-size sizes), `-r`/`-h`/invalid-arg paths, and multi-GPU dispatch — all pass with relative error within tolerance. Note: on this single-node test box, more MPI ranks doesn't win over one GPU at small/medium n (PCIe/broadcast round-trip overhead per panel outweighs the extra GPU compute at this scale) — expected for any distributed dense factorization tested on loopback rather than a real multi-node interconnect; the design's benefit shows at problem sizes that exceed single-GPU memory/compute or on real multi-node clusters."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":373,"cache_read_input_tokens":97933,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":373},"output_tokens":1,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"008560a7-a96a-4c32-a590-c2f4204003ad","uuid":"595c0368-8b8c-454a-a9cf-4ba3fb13efa6","timestamp":"2026-09-06T16:50:25.444Z","request_id":"req_011CenXhWrJ3q3SgpATYMjxX"}
